high: The two-axis completion gate is not structurally enforced. codex-review.mjs accepts verdicts without career_authenticity_score or game_quality_score and applies the axis threshold only when both happen to be present, so a malformed/incomplete PASS can bypass the documented career+game quality gate.

Reviewer independence is violated by the generalized final-review template: it explicitly feeds redesign-proposals.md to Codex even though the generated document contains a producer-authored Claude evaluation and synthesis. This contradicts the acceptance requirement that producers' self-assessments are not fed into review prompts.
medium: A fresh improve scaffold refers to a proposal-review prompt but never creates that prompt or prints an executable codex-task invocation. The proven Xray project had a hand-authored proposal-review-prompt.md, so the generalized workflow does not fully scaffold the feature it promises.

The improve command starts its loop with artifact src/q1/<gameType>, not the registered componentPath it already resolved. For identifiers such as lab_check this is generally a nonexistent path, weakening run provenance and making the recorded artifact misleading.
audit-all ignores the exit status of summarize-audit.mjs, so the command may exit successfully even when the documented audit-summary.md result was not generated.
status labels its output as recent runs but relies on filesystem readdir order and slices the final five entries without sorting by started_at.

audit batch validation only checks r.ok and that r.json is an array. It does not validate batch length, expected game identities, required fields, or scores; duplicate/unexpected records can reach the merged audit as long as every expected ID appears somewhere.
low: loop.mjs does not validate max_iterations as a positive integer, allowing zero, negative, or NaN values to enter run state.
audit-all constructs an unquoted bash command string from filesystem paths. It works in the current workspace but is not reusable in paths containing shell-sensitive characters or spaces.

recommended_actions: Require and validate numeric career_authenticity_score and game_quality_score in codex-review.mjs, enforce their 0-100 ranges, set score to their minimum, and reject missing axes as CODEX_MALFORMED.

Separate producer design intent from producer assessment. Generate an independent-review input containing factual requirements and proposals only, or explicitly restrict proposal review to sections 1-4 as the proven Xray prompt does; do not feed Claude rankings or synthesis into independent review.
Have improve generate proposal-review-prompt.md and print the exact codex-task command, plus create a gameplay-QA placeholder or explicit named template.
Record entry.componentPath as the loop artifact and fail if the gameType is unregistered instead of fabricating a path.
Propagate summarize-audit failure, sort status runs by started_at, validate positive max_iterations, and add strict audit batch schema/identity/uniqueness checks.
